title: Async, and what the one thread is doing
question: There is one thread. What is it doing while you wait?
summary: The event loop, then what that means for an effect that outlives the component that started it. Ends on the race everyone ships at least once: the older response arriving last and winning.

steps.note: One thread, two queues, and what await really suspends.
Three complaints against one box, and two of them are the same race.
